selections.title: Cave Drop
selections.summary: Explore caves where walls and ceilings become walkable surfaces. The latest combat update rewards fighting upside down with a weapon bonus and a compass cue.

selections.title: Blaster Bastards
selections.summary: A revived multiplayer bomb game with new artwork, music, and computer opponents. The creator describes a free Windows and Mac release rebuilt from their original source code.

selections.title: Bannerfall
selections.summary: Compete with three other players to claim resources and defeat a boss. This arcade shoot-out is part of the creator’s Fourfold collection; a larger screen is recommended.

selections.title: Harmony Strike
selections.summary: Control a party of heroes whose positions create elemental bonds. Rescue recruits, evolve weapons, and return to a village between runs. The creator is sharing a trailer while developing the demo.

selections.title: SimCFB
selections.summary: Manage a college football team, recruit players, and call plays or delegate decisions to the computer. The creator announces version 1.0 with Power 4 conference teams.

selections.title: Stompworks
selections.summary: Assemble a cel-shaded mech from interchangeable bodies, legs, and weapons, then take it into combat. Two source posts follow the creator’s progress toward a finished game.

selections.title: 1-Bit Terror
selections.summary: Enter a Halloween maze, contribute collected pumpkins, and escape. The creator’s seasonal event asks the community to work together to unlock avatars.

selections.title: Fallen Nights
selections.summary: Scavenge by day and defend yourself at night. Building defenses consumes the same scrap needed for an escape boat. A Steam demo and browser version are available; the full game is still in development.

selections.title: Worldseed
selections.summary: A retro-styled project approaching launch. The creator shares an in-game teaser after several weeks of iteration, with no public play link included in the post.

selections.title: Ctrl + Alt + Dungeon
selections.summary: An experimental dungeon game shared through Google Playground. Its developer describes building an initial playable version quickly, then iterating on the mechanics and presentation.

selections.title: There Is Eternal War
selections.summary: Organize troops into divisions and assign buildings to supply them. Large maps support broad strategic decisions while players can zoom in to watch battles. A free Steam playtest is open.

selections.title: Evisceracers
selections.summary: A fast 2D platformer focused on chasing records and creating custom maps. The developer is inviting players to test movement, beat existing times, and share feedback.

selections.title: Haltwick
selections.summary: Build transport networks and supply chains while towns expand and their buildings change across eras. The creator describes a release on the App Store and Google Play.

selections.title: Pinky & Bleu: Web Blaster
selections.summary: Two spiders blast approaching bugs, collect power-ups, and chase high scores. The creator links the Android release and says an iOS version is planned.

selections.title: Retro-Mars
selections.summary: A playable browser project accompanied by a trailer. The creator is seeking feedback on the game and its presentation, and notes that the four language versions still need review.

selections.title: Saga of Dilmun
selections.summary: A fantasy and science-fiction MMO with combat, quests, equipment, crafting, and character progression. The developer shares a playable browser version inspired by mythology and unfamiliar worlds.

selections.title: The Lost Colony
selections.summary: An isometric science-fiction action RPG in Unreal Engine. This progress post shows revised movement, hit reactions, enemy behavior, and combat feedback after an earlier round of player criticism.

selections.title: Lawncrest Mall
selections.summary: Explore an abandoned shopping mall in an anomaly horror game. The two-person development team has released a free Steam demo and is seeking feedback on clarity, atmosphere, and frustrating moments.

selections.title: MiniMachines: Steam to Singularity
selections.summary: Start with simple tools on an island and build an automated factory through successive technology tiers. The creator describes steam power, electrical networks, rockets, and multiple worlds in an actively developed free download.

selections.title: Zoo Pet
selections.summary: Grow crops, raise animals, decorate a home, and explore with other players. The solo developer’s browser world also includes character transformations and a server-wide boss encounter.

selections.title: KEEP ON RIDING
selections.summary: Ride from the Italian countryside toward the North Cape, managing fuel, traffic, and route choices. Unlock faster motorcycles as you progress in this free browser work in progress.

selections.title: KAYFABE: Indie Promoter
selections.summary: Run a small wrestling promotion, book shows, balance the budget, and handle backstage personalities. The browser demo covers three shows and includes English and Korean text.

selections.title: Neon Bounty
selections.summary: A cyberpunk-inspired 2D runner designed with mobile play in mind. The creator shares a browser build and screenshots, and invites players to try it.

selections.title: Skyveil Horizon
selections.summary: Previously called Project Anime Glider, this multiplayer project mixes gliding, RPG progression, and arena-game ideas. The creator is preparing an online test and sharing recent gameplay changes.

selections.title: Merkalis: Conquest
selections.summary: A real-time strategy game with battlefield spells. The developer shares a spell demonstration and links a free Steam demo for players to test.

selections.title: Call of Cubie
selections.summary: A browser shooter with a new airfield map and an objective inside a moving transport aircraft. Bots fill empty seats, and the creator recommends desktop play.

selections.title: EXO: Hold the Line
selections.summary: Pilot a war frame against large waves of machines in a voxel arena. The creator’s early alpha footage shows different Vanguard builds, with unfinished systems and bugs still being worked on.

selections.title: The Last Train
selections.summary: Defend a moving train against flying enemies and build up its weapons between waves. The developer links an Android full game and a separate free Steam demo.

selections.title: Plesen'
selections.summary: A work in progress combining digging, simplified factory automation, and combat. The creator is experimenting with the parts of mining and production games they most enjoy.

selections.title: Urban_Sprawl
selections.summary: A city-building project exploring traffic and procedurally generated neighborhoods. This update focuses on fitting varied housing onto angled lots, with citizen improvements planned next.

selections.title: Blood Slayers
selections.summary: A browser game shared with five acts available. The creator identifies a Rust-based implementation and links the playable build; the source provides little additional gameplay detail.

selections.title: Snowbody’s Safe
selections.summary: A browser playtest with a follow-up post from the same creator. The developer is asking what to improve and collecting reactions to the current build.

selections.title: Rise of the Fenarii
selections.summary: A two-person team is developing a strategy RPG from a tower-defense starting point. Worldbuilding, story, and distinctive boss encounters are central to the project’s direction.

selections.title: NEON AFTERHOURS
selections.summary: An office worker escapes into action-film fantasies. Navigate lethal top-down encounters, stealth objectives, and hostage situations, then return home between films. The browser beta supports keyboard, mouse, and gamepad.

selections.title: Backpack Ascendancy
selections.summary: A backpack battler built around planning item layouts and pursuing powerful roguelite runs. The developer shares gameplay and a Steam page while continuing balance work ahead of release.

selections.title: Tiny Forge
selections.summary: Choose equipment and skills, then decide how far to push each expedition. This browser dungeon runner’s first season adds loot filtering, clearer gear comparisons, and guest play.

selections.title: Futbol Warriors
selections.summary: Short soccer matches become medieval skirmishes as knights, mages, and berserkers compete. The creator shares an alpha and asks whether the mix of scoring and fighting feels fun.

selections.title: Misty and the Last Breeze
selections.summary: Run, wall-run, and swing through compact stages, then summon an airboard to grind and perform tricks. The solo developer is refining movement and level design in Godot.

selections.title: VECTOR: Anti-gravity Racing
selections.summary: Race anti-gravity craft across five circuits, including a lunar track. The creator announces version 1.00 with a career mode and online races for up to eight players.

selections.title: StoneEra
selections.summary: Design buildings as reusable plans and let villagers construct them. The latest demo update adds scaffolding, improved building tools, production targets, and shared research to this medieval colony simulation.

selections.title: RC Vibe GP
selections.summary: A radio-controlled racing project with local and online multiplayer experiments. The developer describes working courses, rival-car tuning, and additional modes including arena battles and capture the flag.

selections.title: Idle Freelance
selections.summary: An idle game returning with improvements after community feedback. The creator shares a free playable version and invites another round of player reactions.

selections.title: DOMDIVE
selections.summary: Descend through a hazardous vertical platformer as the difficulty rises. Share a level seed to challenge friends with the same layout. The browser game is free and needs no account.

selections.title: A Place Beyond
selections.summary: Explore a world based on the creator’s drawings, gather companions, and face bosses. This browser prototype includes boats, parkour, and bullet-hell encounters, with keyboard and gamepad support.

selections.title: HALKO
selections.summary: A forest-work game inspired by gathering winter firewood with family. The creator shares a playable demo and asks whether the repetitive work translates into satisfying play.

selections.title: HEATSINK
selections.summary: A drone racing game with a new map, revised drones, power-ups, and performance improvements. The creator is collecting feedback on what to add next.

selections.title: Smokestack
selections.summary: Guide an industrial business beginning in 1991. Decisions about contracts, quality, debt, and family compound over time as historical events change the conditions around the company.

selections.title: Arkansas 2125
selections.summary: A post-apocalyptic game sharing its beta 0.7 update. The creator highlights larger interface elements and Polish localization, with changes intended to make handheld play easier.

selections.title: A Snowboard Dream
selections.summary: An endless snowboarding game without objectives or score pressure. The creator designed it for short breaks or relaxed play while listening to something else.

selections.title: Fallen Heroes
selections.summary: A first-time creator shares footage of a JRPG approaching completion. The source is a progress showcase with a video, rather than a public download announcement.

selections.title: Idle Idiots
selections.summary: An incremental auto-battler with irreverent humor, unusual legendary equipment, achievements, and a snapshot-based PvP arena. The creator is inviting players to try the current browser build.

selections.title: The Residual
selections.summary: A short narrative platformer about memory, loneliness, and relationships in a fractured world. The developer describes a 20–30 minute experience and links the free Steam release.

selections.title: ORRA
selections.summary: Stained-glass knights wall-run, slide, and flip through a cathedral arena above the water. The creator shares a playable experiment built in Spawn.

selections.title: Astralight: Pilgrim's Duel
selections.summary: A fantasy trading-card game with a newly opened Steam playtest. Its guided tutorial introduces the battle interface, mana, attacks, and other turn mechanics.

selections.title: Abyss Drift
selections.summary: An early multiplayer experiment shared through Google Playground. The creator is looking for feedback on the playable build and ideas for its next direction.

selections.title: Three Touches
selections.summary: An arcade volleyball project with player, club, and referee careers. A charged spike slows the action so the player can choose a target; the creator describes ongoing testing of desktop builds.

selections.title: Super Mekabots
selections.summary: A browser mecha card game in development. This showcase follows an attack from the card board into an animated battle and back, with a focus on making the result easy to read.

selections.title: AI Says
selections.summary: Guide a person through dangerous test chambers by typing instructions to a blind in-game AI. Precise descriptions matter. The creators share a trailer ahead of their planned release.

selections.title: Looks Legit
selections.summary: Paint inexpensive imitations that fool deliberately limited automated art appraisers. Learn what each model can perceive, then exploit its blind spots. Browser and desktop versions are available.

selections.title: Grayfall
selections.summary: The creator tests an early level on a handheld device and shares unedited gameplay. The project is still in development, with feedback sought on the current atmosphere and feel.

selections.title: Parallax Runner
selections.summary: Run across rainy rooftops while other players race in parallel lanes. A pursuing drone retraces your route, and markers show where earlier runners failed. No signup is required.

selections.title: Somnaworld
selections.summary: Explore, build, and survive by day, then make dream choices that alter the waking world. The first public alpha includes combat, dungeons, and persistent changes to the landscape.

selections.title: HALFTIME Manager
selections.summary: Run a football club through training, league play, and cups. The creator’s early-access management game includes fictional teams, local hotseat play, and support for community-made worlds.

selections.title: Links Manager
selections.summary: Manage a golf academy, recruit juniors, hire coaches, and plan tournaments across multiple seasons. The creator links a full game and a separate browser demo covering one season.

selections.title: NIGHT SHIFT
selections.summary: Work a night shift with friends, complete tasks, and hide from a creature stalking the store. The creator shares a free browser build through a project showcase page.

selections.title: Astronormous Survivor
selections.summary: Steer a small ship through waves while automatic weapons handle the firing. Spend loot between waves to grow the hull into a heavily armed vessel. An iPhone TestFlight build is open.

selections.title: Hearsay
selections.summary: Reassemble fragments of historical recordings by listening and arranging tapes. This first-person puzzle project uses archival audio, with a Steam demo planned but not yet announced as available in the source post.

selections.title: TIBERAVA
selections.summary: An early strategy project combining city-building, large battles, and roguelite influences. The creator shares a playable alpha and recommends desktop for the best experience.

selections.title: Lanterns of Aldermere
selections.summary: A village lantern has gone dark and its keeper is missing. Follow two heroes into forests and ruins in the playable first chapter of a turn-based pixel-art RPG.

selections.title: OUTPERFORM
selections.summary: A stock-market-themed roguelike with an open Steam playtest. The developer is asking about first-run clarity, upgrade choices, and whether players want to return for another run.

selections.title: Derelict Division, LLC
selections.summary: Explore abandoned spacecraft with up to three friends, dismantle them, and carry out useful salvage. The solo developer shares a new Steam page while the game remains in development.

selections.title: Iron Vigil
selections.summary: A side-scrolling survivor game designed for Game Boy Advance hardware and emulators. The creator shares a demoable work in progress with generated artwork and music.

selections.title: Bastigard: Match Merge Defend
selections.summary: Merge resources into defensive structures and protect a castle from dragon waves. The studio announces an Android release built around short sessions and one-handed play.
